meta.title: Cancer Oncology & Molecular Therapeutics Multi-Paper Synthesis (7 Papers)
meta.authors: Hanahan D, Ribas A, Donehower LA, Canon J, June CH, Lord CJ, Soria JC, et al.
meta.summary: Cross-disciplinary synthesis of 7 seminal cancer oncology studies encompassing immune checkpoint blockade (PD-1/PD-L1), TP53 tumor suppressor inactivation, direct KRAS G12C oncogene inhibition, synthetic lethality via PARP inhibitors, third-generation EGFR TKIs, and CAR T-cell cellular therapy.

articles.title: Hallmarks of cancer: new dimensions and emerging hallmarks in neoplastic transformation
articles.summary: Defines core biological capabilities acquired during multistep development of human tumors including sustaining proliferative signaling, evading growth suppressors, and avoiding immune destruction.

articles.title: Targeting the PD-1/PD-L1 immune checkpoint pathway in human cancer
articles.summary: Mechanisms of adaptive immune resistance where tumor cells upregulate PD-L1 to suppress cytotoxic CD8+ T cells, and therapeutic reversal using monoclonal antibody checkpoint inhibitors.

articles.title: Integrated analysis of TP53 gene mutations and tumor suppressor network inactivation across human cancers
articles.authors: Donehower LA, Soussi T, Korkut A, et al.
articles.summary: Pan-cancer characterization of 10,225 patient samples demonstrating p53 pathway deregulation, loss of apoptotic control, and chromosomal instability driving therapy resistance.

articles.title: The clinical landscape of KRAS G12C inhibitors and mutant-selective oncogene targeting in solid tumors
articles.authors: Canon J, Rex K, Saiki AY, et al.
articles.summary: Discloses small-molecule covalent inhibitor sotorasib (AMG 510) locking mutant KRAS(G12C) in an inactive GDP-bound state, breaking the dogma of KRAS as an undruggable target.

articles.title: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell immunotherapy in hematologic malignancies and solid tumors
articles.summary: Principles of genetically redirecting patient T cells with synthetic receptors targeting cell-surface lineage antigens such as CD19, driving durable remissions.

articles.title: BRCAness, homologous recombination deficiency, and PARP inhibitor synthetic lethality in cancer therapy
articles.summary: Translates defective homologous recombination repair in BRCA1/2-deficient tumor cells into targeted synthetic lethality using poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) catalytic inhibitors.

articles.title: Osimertinib in untreated EGFR-mutated advanced non-small-cell lung cancer
articles.authors: Soria JC, Ohe Y, Vansteenkiste J, et al.
articles.summary: Demonstrated superior progression-free and overall survival for third-generation CNS-penetrant EGFR-TKI osimertinib over standard TKIs in EGFR-sensitizing and T790M mutant NSCLC.

nodes.name: TP53 Tumor Suppressor
nodes.desc: Guardian of the genome; mutated in >50% of cancers leading to loss of DNA damage checkpoint.

nodes.name: KRAS G12C Oncogene
nodes.desc: Activating driver mutation locking GTPase in active signaling state; targeted by sotorasib.

nodes.name: Programmed Death-1 (PD-1)
nodes.desc: Inhibitory immune checkpoint receptor expressed on activated cytotoxic T lymphocytes.

nodes.name: PD-L1 (CD274)
nodes.desc: Immunosuppressive ligand upregulated on tumor cells and myeloid cells binding PD-1.

nodes.name: EGFR Kinase (Exon 19/L858R)
nodes.desc: Receptor tyrosine kinase driving non-small cell lung cancer proliferation and survival.

nodes.name: BRCA1 / BRCA2 Genes
nodes.desc: Essential mediators of homologous recombination repair of DNA double-strand breaks.

nodes.name: PARP1 Enzyme
nodes.desc: Nuclear enzyme repairing single-strand DNA breaks; therapeutic target in HRD tumors.

nodes.name: CD19 B-Cell Antigen
nodes.desc: Lineage-specific surface glycoprotein targeted by chimeric antigen receptor T cells.

nodes.name: VEGFA Angiogenic Factor
nodes.desc: Primary promoter of tumor neovascularization and endothelial cell sprouting.

nodes.name: MAPK/ERK Cascade
nodes.desc: Downstream oncogenic cascade activated by mutant KRAS and EGFR stimulating cell division.

nodes.name: Homologous Recombination Repair
nodes.desc: Error-free DNA repair pathway whose inactivation confers sensitivity to PARP trapping.

nodes.name: Apoptotic Signaling Pathway
nodes.desc: Programmed cell death pathway normally activated by p53 upon severe DNA damage.

nodes.name: Immune Checkpoint Evasion
nodes.desc: Extrinsic pathway through which malignant clones escape cytotoxic T cell-mediated lysis.

nodes.name: PI3K/AKT/mTOR Network
nodes.desc: Crucial metabolic and survival signaling axis hyperactivated in diverse human carcinomas.

nodes.name: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda)
nodes.desc: High-affinity humanized anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody restoring antitumor immune response.

nodes.name: Sotorasib (AMG 510)
nodes.desc: First-in-class covalent small molecule irreversibly trapping KRAS G12C in GDP-bound state.

nodes.name: Osimertinib (Tagrisso)
nodes.desc: Potent irreversible 3rd-generation EGFR-TKI with selectivity over wild-type EGFR.

nodes.name: Olaparib (Lynparza)
nodes.desc: PARP inhibitor trapping PARP-DNA complexes leading to lethal double-strand breaks in HRD.

nodes.name: CD19-Directed CAR-T Cells
nodes.desc: Autologous T cells engineered with single-chain variable fragment and 4-1BB/CD28 costimulation.

nodes.name: Comprehensive Genomic Profiling (NGS)
nodes.desc: High-throughput panel assay identifying targetable mutations, TMB, and MSI status.

nodes.name: PD-L1 IHC 22C3 Companion Diagnostic
nodes.desc: Immunohistochemical companion diagnostic measuring tumor proportion score (TPS).

nodes.name: Circulating Tumor DNA (ctDNA)
nodes.desc: Non-invasive plasma assay monitoring minimal residual disease and emergent resistance mutations.

nodes.name: Cytotoxic CD8+ T Lymphocytes
nodes.desc: Primary cellular effectors mediating tumor antigen recognition and perforin/granzyme lysis.

nodes.name: Immunosuppressive TME
nodes.desc: Complex stromal niche composed of cancer-associated fibroblasts, Tregs, and myeloid cells.

nodes.name: Synthetic Lethality
nodes.desc: Cell death occurring when two genetic deficiencies occur simultaneously (BRCA1/2 + PARP).

nodes.name: T790M Gatekeeper Mutation
nodes.desc: Steric hindrance mutation in EGFR kinase domain conferring resistance to 1st-gen TKIs.
